scope: MQuAKE-derived controlled continuous-memory experiment; not a natural-language benchmark
training_information: All unique original atomic facts from structurally eligible MQuAKE cases; no two-hop target supervision
evaluation: All unique eligible original two-hop chains; candidate outputs are all entities in the retained graph
ambiguity_policy: Exclude every chain containing a subject-relation key with multiple object IDs in the source subset
policy: All 12 configurations and both interfaces; no outcome-selected width, seed, or case; oracle clean queries and certificates are offline diagnostics
